resolved.reasoning: ACP domain with phosphopantetheine attachment site provides the structural basis for acyl group binding via thioester bond formation.
Acyl Carrier Protein domain with phosphopantetheine binding sites; the phosphopantetheine prosthetic group is the canonical acyl-carrying cofactor in ACPs.
ACP (Acyl Carrier Protein) domain with phosphopantetheine cofactor directly binds and carries acyl groups during fatty acid/polyketide synthesis.
